title: Chicken Crumble with Algerian Spice
description: A flavorful and spicy chicken dish topped with a crunchy crumble. Serve as a main course or enjoy as a snack.
instructions: Season the chicken with salt and pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned on both sides.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 15-20 minutes or until cooked through.
While the chicken is cooking, prepare the crumble topping by mixing the buttery crumble topping with a pinch of salt.
Remove the chicken from the oven and top with the crumble topping.
Return the chicken to the oven and bake for an additional 5-7 minutes or until the topping is golden brown.
